title: CADEX Race GC Tire
notes: Official US store read 2026-11-01: US$100; sizes 700x28 and 700x30 offered. Specification shown for 700x28: 279 g, ETRTO 28-622, max 95 psi (6.6 bar), 240 TPI Supple Race Casing, Kevlar/carbon composite folding bead, RR-S compound, Race Shield. Described as a lightweight tubeless tire balancing speed, cornering grip and durability.
